purpose: Exercise the complete gamification data, review, training, evaluation, and replacement workflow before authorized human evidence exists.

annotation_guide.unit: One fictional learner interaction with its item, observable response evidence, and pre-support context.
annotation_guide.primary_label_rule: Choose the narrowest supported provisional misconception label; use unknown/other when one interaction cannot distinguish plausible explanations.
annotation_guide.incorrect_answer_rule: An incorrect answer is evidence of an error, not automatic proof of a misconception.
annotation_guide.independence_rule: Each reviewer labels without seeing the other review.
annotation_guide.adjudication_rule: Retain an agreed label when evidence supports it; otherwise select unknown/other and preserve the disagreement rationale.

fictional_reviewer_profiles.example_qualification: Primary mathematics teacher with Grade 5 classroom experience
Mathematics curriculum specialist with assessment-design experience
Primary English teacher with literacy-intervention experience
English curriculum specialist with language-assessment experience

example_data_governance.retention: retain while needed for development regression tests
example_data_governance.withdrawal: not applicable because no person contributed data
example_data_governance.deletion: remove or archive this package after an authorized replacement passes validation
example_data_governance.real_data_rule: Do not add real learner or reviewer data to this package.

threshold_scope: Synthetic workflow smoke-test thresholds only; they are not research, safety, efficacy, or release thresholds.
